### ***GEMTEK** Products* formulates and manufactures industrial cleaners, degreasers, solvents and
### specialty chemicals derived from renewable, biobased resources.

As a pioneer in the biobased industry, **GEMTEK** Products remains steadfast in its commitment to
the research, development, and manufacturing of non-toxic, environmentally safe cleaners,
degreasers, solvents, and specialty chemicals. Since 1992, **GEMTEK** has played a key role in the
global transition away from petroleum- and synthetic-based chemistries toward sustainable,
plant-based alternatives. By combining advanced green chemistry with performance standards, the
company has consistently delivered products that meet the demand of industrial, commercial, and
institutional users without compromising environmental integrity or worker safety.

Over the past three decades, **GEMTEK** has built a reputation for innovation, reliability, and
regulatory leadership, helping organizations reduce hazardous waste, lower VOC emissions, and
support safer workplace practices. Through a strong focus on sustainability, compliance, and
customer-driven innovation, **GEMTEK** continues to shape the future of worldwide environmental
responsibility.

What We Do

## We make fuel from waste.
## Not as a compromise — as an upgrade.

Greenjoules is a deep-tech biorefinery operating from Chakan, Pune. We take agri-waste and
agro-industrial residues — materials that would otherwise be burned in open fields — and convert
them through a proprietary thermochemical process into second-generation biofuels that are
chemically indistinguishable from their fossil counterparts.

The critical difference: our fuels carry among the lowest lifecycle carbon footprints of any fuel
available anywhere in the world today. And unlike first-generation biofuels, not a single food crop
is diverted.

🌾

#### Zero food vs. fuel conflict

Agricultural residues only — rice husk, sugarcane press mud, paddy straw. No cropland diverted. No
food chain disrupted.

🔬

#### Proprietary process technology

Our thermochemical conversion process is developed and owned entirely by our team. No licensed IP,
no royalty dependency — full technical control at every step.

⛽

#### True drop-in replacement

Meets BIS:1460 (Indian diesel standard). Surpasses Euro VI. No engine or infrastructure modification
required — it simply replaces fossil diesel, litre for litre.

## Economic Bioplastic to Finally beat Petrochemical Plastic.

At Sustainable Chemicals™, we are bringing novel bioplastics materials to market that will
revolutionize how bioplastics are adopted and used. Our ambitious goal is backed by economics and
superior performance, existing bioplastics can’t match, and will enable us to bring sustainable
bioplastics to producers and consumers in the plastics industry.

## **OUR MISSION IS TO SOLVE THE PLASTIC PROBLEM
## **

> *″Bioplastics have been around for decades, but the technology remains limited to niche
> applications because they have inferior properties and are more expensive than traditional
> plastics. The only way to achieve meaningful environmental change is to design a bioplastic that
> is cost and performance competitive with petroleum-based plastics. That is why I founded
> Sustainable Chemicals™.″*
> 
> **
> 
> * – Silvia Luebben, Sust-Chem CEO and Founder*
> 
> **
> 
> **
> 
> **

### Novel BioPlastics

We have novel bioplastics platform made from raw material obtained from biomass. This reduces the
carbon footprint of our product by 45% compared to petrochemical plastics.

### BioDegradation

If dispersed in the environment, Sust-Chem’s bioplastics degrade into benign molecules that can be
used by nature as building blocks.

If collected, our biopolymers can be chemically recycled.

### Cost-competitive

Petrochemical plastics are ubiquitous because they are convenient and cheap. Our chemistry does not
require fermentation compared to other bioplastics, which allows us to scale economically and become
cost-competitive with the petrochemical plastics.

### Actual Plastic Properties

Existing bioplastic products do not have a plastic look, feel, or application. Our bioplastics are
designed to have properties that match conventional petrochemical plastics to provide diverse
product applications.

## We Have the Power to Impact Our Future, and We’re Doing Something About It

 We are drowning in plastic pollution. 
* By the year 2050 there will be more plastic in the ocean than fish .
* Non-biodegradable plastics breakdown into smaller fragments, called microplastics, which enter our
  drinking water and food supply.  Each person consumes about half a pound of microplastics per
  year.
* Plastic manufacture and incineration accounts for 13% of global carbon dioxide emissions, a
  leading cause of global warming.
* Only 9% of plastic is actually recycled.
* Current alternatives to conventional polymers have made great technological advances, however
  their used is limited to niche applications because their cost is higher and their performance in
  inferior to that of conventional fossil fuel based plastics.

## OUR DUTY

## Bring to market a family of sustainable bioplastics that compete with petrochemical plastics in
## price and performance. 

## BIODEGRADABLE

Our material has a benign end of life whether it is recycled, up-cycled or lost to the environment.

[Learn More][6]

## RENEWABLE

The monomer is sourced from biomass which allows us to reduce the carbon footprint of our plastics
by 45%.

[Learn More][7]

## NONPERSISTANT

Our plastic breaks down into benign materials if improperly disposed.

[Learn More][8]

## NONTOXIC

The monomer is present in soy sauce and has a natural metabolic pathway.

[Learn More][9]

## PROPERTIES

Mechanical properties of our biopolymer match conventional plastics.

[Learn More][10]
